g.title: PionPipeline
g.text: Tested media and feedback path · FFmpeg is offline; interceptors are inside each Pion process

g.title: prep
g.text: Before the test · on the Mac
File copied to the Ubuntu sender using SCP
FFmpeg does not run in the live media loop

g.title: sender
g.text: Frame ticker repeats them at the file's frame rate
Go pacer applies rate + byte-window limits
STUN, DTLS and RTCP stay Non-ECT
Feedback input to the same process
The application's ReadRTCP loop drives reads
Outputs pacing rate and packet window

g.title: control
g.text: Python testbed helper + SSH launch peers
Setup traffic is separate from video

g.title: network
g.text: Same physical path and UDP ICE pair
Capture taps: NSI enp2s0 / CMCI enp3s0

g.title: receiver
g.text: Save IP ECN bits + arrival time before decryption
Keep the visible RTP SSRC / sequence identity
Consume saved socket ECN only after authentication
Pion ccfb.Recorder stores packet timing + ECN
Count RTP packets / payload / ECT(1) / CE
This test consumes packets without video playback
ICE / UDP mux → same socket, Non-ECT

g.title: capture
g.text: Observes traffic; does not relay the video

g.title: missing
g.text: It does not change the saved VP8 file or run FFmpeg.
Source-frame timing and pacing waits are rate gates
to investigate for the observed ~9 Mbps plateau.
